_why: M4 deep dive end state, read after section 4 and before the deep dive's Teardown. SIMULATED: the devices are synthetic, published by the upstream example driver. Object state only: the claim's driver-written device status, the DeviceTaintRule's condition and the evicted Pod's absence, and the driver DaemonSet's env. State-tolerant: every object read is one the deep dive itself seeds in m4-deepdive or the addon layer it recreates, never an object of the lab. Every kubectl sets KUBECONFIG and --context kind-grid-core. matches are anchored, with no lookaround and no backreference. Run it from the labs repo root: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m4/deep-dive.checks.json).

checks.describe: section 3: claim dd-status-claim, made while the driver ran with GPU_DEVICE_STATUS=true, carries at least one status.devices entry written by the renamed driver. An absent claim prints nothing and fails
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m4-deepdive get resourceclaim dd-status-claim -o json | jq -r 'if ([.status.devices[]? | select(.driver == "sim-accelerator.example.com")] | length) > 0 then "devices-status=written" else "devices-status=empty" end'

checks.describe: section 4: DeviceTaintRule sim-evict-demo exists, its EvictionInProgress condition reads False (the eviction it caused has finished), and Pod taint-victim is gone
checks.run: sh -c 'export KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}"; r=$(kubectl --context kind-grid-core get devicetaintrule sim-evict-demo -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r "if .metadata.name == \"sim-evict-demo\" then \"present \" + ([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == \"EvictionInProgress\") | .status][0] // \"unset\") else \"absent\" end"); set -- $r; rule="${1:-absent}"; case "${2:-}" in False) ev=done;; "") ev=unknown;; *) ev="$2";; esac; v=$(kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m4-deepdive get pod taint-victim --ignore-not-found -o name); if [ -z "$v" ]; then vic=absent; else vic=present; fi; echo "rule=$rule eviction=$ev victim=$vic"'

checks.describe: section 3 restored: the driver DaemonSet template carries GPU_DEVICE_STATUS="false" again after rollout undo
checks.run: sh -c 'printf "GPU_DEVICE_STATUS=%s\n" "$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n dra-example-driver get ds dra-example-driver-kubeletplugin -o jsonpath="{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name==\"plugin\")].env[?(@.name==\"GPU_DEVICE_STATUS\")].value}")"'
